items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: what was that theater that Josephine Baker

ctx.x: St. Germain. That was the name of the club. The owner of the club somehow decided to put together Art Blakey and Kenny Clarke with the Messengers. We just added Kenny Clarke to the Messengers. We played a couple nights in the club. It was paradise. Both of these drummers, and they complement each other. When one was active, the other took a lesser role, and vice versa, so that you could hear each one of them clearly, whereas if they were doing the same thing, it’s scrambled eggs. Then he
decided, this is so good, let’s take them into – what was that theater that Josephine Baker . . . ?
